summary: Fresh-context adversary review of fable5-config-slimdown Phase 3 implementation. Re-ran tests/verify.sh independently: 17 PASS / 0 FAIL / 3 SKIP(tier-2), reproducing sprint-1-green-phase.log byte-for-byte. Manually traced bash variable expansion for all 8 PROP-P7a files (self-fix.sh, capafy/reddit/life-manager-loop-cli.sh, clip-promote/video/clip-cli.sh, adversary-daily.sh): confirmed via `git show af6783b` that each edit is a pure single-line insertion of `VAR="${VAR} ...PushNotification..."` placed strictly between the original assign-span (byte-identical to HEAD, verified by diff) and the launch line (byte-identical to pre-P7a text, with adversary-daily.sh's launch line correctly reflecting REQ-P5a's prior --model opus addition per the iteration-3 FIND-007 per-operation convention) — the appended text is structurally guaranteed to be part of the runtime prompt value, not a dead string. adversary-daily.sh's append text is correctly FAIL-verdict-limited ('検証結果がFAIL verdictだった場合のみ...PASSの場合やnarration・定常報告には使わない'); the other 7 use the general wording, matching REQ-P7b's EARS text almost verbatim. Tier-2 judgment: PROP-P2b-judgment PASS (session-architecture.md 93→16 lines, all 4 required points — batch independent tool calls, prefer lighter tools, Edit over Write, offload heavy round-trips to subagent — clearly present in natural language, zero banned strings). PROP-P5b judgment half PASS (new CLAUDE.md row names security-audit/offensive-cyber tasks + Opus 4.8 + explicit safety-classifier-refusal fallback). REQ-SAFE-3 invariants (enabledPlugins, includeGitInstructions, cozempic command set, context7.md md5) verified byte/hash-identical independently. ~/.openclaw git diff exists but is unrelated live-runtime/browser-profile churn from an always-on separate process, touching none of this feature's target files. P3's partial abort — building-effective-ai-agents.md left in ~/.claude/rules/ instead of moving to references/ — is correct: move-ref-check.log records a real hits=1 for form=tilde under ~/.openclaw/skills, and grep confirms two genuine non-CLAUDE.md referencing lines (yakobus/scripts/search_buses.py:6, anicca-core/scripts/tier2-agent-diagnose.sh:12); REQ-P3a's own edge case mandates aborting the move for that specific file only, which is exactly what happened, with CLAUDE.md's reference-table row annotated accordingly. All 27 move-ref-check.log lines verified as genuine unique (file x dir x form) combinations covering the required 3x3x3 matrix. REQ-P6a/P6b independently reproduced (jq checks, git log/status/fetch against origin/feature/clip-rewards confirm committed+pushed, no drift). No blocking or major findings.
